relevance_note: Single-centre series of five children with LAD-I and ITGB2 mutations treated by UCBT, with some individual-level detail ("One patient had severe LAD-I with the level of CD18-expressing neutrophils being 0.8%"), although Tables 1-4 are absent from this web-page conversion (only 'Full table' links).
method_note: The Markdown is a publisher web-page scrape; Tables 1-3 (per-patient UCBT characteristics, clinical characteristics, complications/outcome) and Table 4 (9 literature UCBT patients) are not in the text (only 'Full table' placeholders), so no per-patient variants, sexes, ages or features are available and no variant is printed (variant rows kept with 'not reported'). The paper has no patient labels. Five rows 'unnamed person 1-5': person 1 is the single patient with severe LAD-I (CD18 0.8%), first individually mentioned; persons 2-5 are 'the other four patients' with moderate LAD-I and cannot be told apart. Only statements naming 'all five'/'all the patients' or 'the other four' were applied to rows. Individual-level statements that cannot be tied to any row were NOT assigned: two boys and three girls; median age at diagnosis 13 months (range 4-120) and at UCBT; one patient died of bronchiolitis obliterans/respiratory failure 8 months after UCBT (four alive); aGvHD in four (one grade IV skin/liver, one grade II skin, one grade III skin/gut, one grade II skin); post-UCBT CMV viremia in two, sepsis in two (E. coli, P. aeruginosa), bronchiolitis obliterans in two; and a fragment (preceding text missing from the conversion) 'The onset symptom of the other patient was a dental ulcer and gingivitis at the age of one year.' Pre-transplant complications are given as counts only ('five cases of pneumonia, three cases of omphalitis, three cases of skin and soft tissue infections, two cases of sepsis, and two cases of intestinal infection'); counts of cases without names were not assigned, including the 5 pneumonia cases (cases may not equal patients). Post-transplant CD18 normalization ('all results being normal' at day +60) was treated as a treatment outcome, not as exclusion of the pre-transplant CD18 deficiency. 'Typical granulocytosis' was mapped to the checklist item 'leukocytosis or neutrophilia'. Previously published UCBT patients in the Discussion (Hamidieh ref 19, Al-Dhekri ref 20, Qasim ref 18) are described only by conditioning regimen and engraftment/chimerism outcome, with no sex, age, variant or clinical feature, so they are out of scope under v4. Methods text cites ref (12) for sequencing methods but does not state that these patients were previously reported, so cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null. Contradictions in the paper: age range at UCBT is '8 to 32 months' in the abstract but '8 to 132 months' in Methods; aGvHD grades are 'grade II-IV' in Results but 'grade II/III aGvHD' in the Discussion. The abstract Background sentence is truncated in the conversion. JSON was built with a short Python script from my reading; spans checked verbatim by script.
